sources: hosted Privilege gateway pod log, Elasticsearch ping-siem-events, OpenSearch gateway-events
requirement: a. User on whose behalf the MCP tool call was made
b. Agent identity acting on behalf of the user
d. What was the authorization policy decision

sinks.name: Gateway pod log (cyonproxy.log)
sinks.summary: Detailed lines for single-app MCP routes; almost nothing for aggregate, A2A and LLM routes.

sinks.name: PingGateway X-Gw-Audit-Trail header
sinks.summary: mcpAudit record with user, agent, tool, decision. Returned to the caller only; not stored. Not captured in this run.

sinks.name: Console Activity Log and Agent Insights
sinks.summary: Local-proxy rows lack tool, decision and agent. Agent Insights shows AI Guard verdicts for LLM routes. Not re-checked for the cases here.

sinks.name: Elasticsearch ping-siem-events
sinks.summary: Console REST API changes only (1,400 events). Zero events for any case.

sinks.name: OpenSearch gateway-events
sinks.summary: Shipper sends LLM, AI Guard and A2A events only. Newest event 2026-10-26.
